summary: Iteration 333 - Staff Portal Dynamic Theming Testing. All theme features working correctly: 1) DiaGyn Staff Portal - Dr. Vikas Deep Teal theme (neon green #A6FF4D accents) and Dr. Neha Deep Plum theme (pink #EC4899 accents) toggle working, header icon/FAB/staff name colors change dynamically. 2) Orange Pharmacy Staff Portal - Orange theme with accent bar at top, warm header background (#FFF7ED), orange staff name (#EA580C), orange FAB. 3) Mango Labs Staff Portal - Green/Emerald theme with green header icon, emerald-400 staff name, green dashboard label, green active tabs, green FAB (#22C55E). All FAB buttons render correctly. Clinic toggle (Pushpa/Amnion) works alongside doctor tabs. No console errors detected.
